phase_rules.no_reuse: A raw probe and receiving call are different invocations. Never copy a probe output/page into the receiving observation. Public decide exposes a Result, not raw memory.
phase_rules.stopping: One frozen ordered inventory. Preserve every attempt/mismatch/partial output. Admission cases are never executed even if unexpectedly accepted; record failure and run fresh C1. phase_rules.result_publication: Exclusive private stage and result paths; reject duplicate/missing/unordered rows, wrong pins and unknown fields.
